title: Vintage French Cast Iron Cocotte – Made in France – Rare Sparkling Green
description:
Beautiful vintage cast iron cocotte, made in France, featuring a rare deep green enamel with a subtle sparkling / sanded effect. A distinctive and elegant piece, perfect for everyday cooking or display.
✔️ Made in France – quality traditional craftsmanship
✔️ Unique color – dark green with a lightly textured, shimmering finish
✔️ Condition: good vintage
Interior clean with normal signs of use
Exterior glossy with light marks consistent with age
✔️ Matching lid with integrated handle
📏 Approximate dimensions:
Diameter: ~28–30 cm
Height: ~12–13 cm
💡 Compatible with all heat sources (including induction and oven)
💡 Excellent heat retention – ideal for slow cooking, stews, and braised dishes
A rare vintage find with a unique finish, offering both charm and performance—perfect for those who appreciate authentic French cookware.

fr.title: Cocotte française vintage en fonte – Fabriquée en France – Rare vert pailleté

✔️ Fabriquée en France – savoir-faire traditionnel de qualité
